items.t: Frame rusts through
items.job: Repair or reinforce rusted frame sections
items.note: Owners report an average of about $1,200. Severe rot may not be worth fixing.

items.t: Rear suspension link brackets rust off the frame (recall)
items.job: Inspect, treat or reinforce rear lower link brackets
items.note: Free at an Isuzu-authorized shop if it was never done. Isuzu no longer sells vehicles in the US, so call ahead to confirm who handles recalls.

items.t: Rear suspension bracket corrosion (recall)
items.job: Inspect, treat or reinforce rear lower link bracket
items.note: Free at an Isuzu-authorized shop if it was never done. Isuzu no longer sells vehicles in the US, so call ahead to confirm who handles recalls.

items.t: V6 burns oil and can fail
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report an average of $2,700 to $4,300. A used engine costs less than a rebuilt one.

items.t: Engine knocking and loss of compression at high mileage
items.job: Replace engine with used unit

items.t: Coolant leak on top of the engine
items.job: Replace leaking intake-area gaskets or hoses
items.note: Owners report about $2,600 on average, which suggests intake or head work.

items.t: Starter fails and engine won't turn over
items.job: Replace starter

items.t: Automatic transmission slips or shifts roughly
items.job: Repair or replace automatic transmission
items.note: Owners report about $1,900 for rough shifting. A range switch alone costs much less.

items.t: Stalls at stops and is hard to start
items.job: Diagnose stalling and replace faulty sensor

items.t: Throttle position sensor fails

items.t: Reduced power and stalling at highway speed
